requiredFields.name: human-readable pattern name
requiredFields.status: SHADOW (propose only) | RETIRED. No pattern may declare an applying status; Repairbuddy never applies.
requiredFields.seamCode: exact Technical Glasses priority code this pattern addresses, e.g. CONTRACT_INVALID

match.messagePattern: ECMAScript regex source matched against the seam message. Capture groups become typed slots.
match.slots: array of { name, group, type } where group is the 1-based capture group and type is one of: identifier, permission, relative-path, integer

proposal.operation: one operation id understood by the kernel: insert-into-manifest-uses | create-missing-file-from-template | report-only
proposal.verification: array of shell commands a human or big model runs to judge the proposal; Repairbuddy itself never executes them

lineage.sourceRepair: path to the action report or patch note this pattern was distilled from
lineage.verifiedBy: the verification evidence that the source repair passed

boundaries: A pattern with no lineage.sourceRepair is invalid: Repairbuddy only learns from repairs that really happened here.
Slots render only from capture groups; free prose from any source never reaches a proposal.
Unknown seamCode or failed match is not an error: it is an escalation.
